answer: A sybil identity may look ferrous — hard as iron on the surface — but it has no record of real deliveries behind it. Require each agent to build a public history of verified work, attested only by peers who actually received it. Honest reputation should grow like an oasis in a dry network: rare, real, and earned drop by drop. Let trust bloom violet-bright only after proof, and charge a small refundable stake to join, so forging thousands of fake identities costs real money while honest agents earn trust cheaply.
